No, that's not covered. Yellowing of one or two older leaves in the first two weeks is normal transplant stress—our guarantee only covers significant decline, which means losing more than a third of the plant's leaves, stem or root rot, or collapse.

Your pothos should settle in fine over the next week or two. Make sure you're watering only when the top inch of soil is dry, as overwatering is the most common early issue. If you need care tips, our Plant Care Specialists are available free by chat or email.
